title: Step 5: Report: prequential curves, checkpoints, spend table
description:
## Purpose

Step 5: report generator.

## Scope

Prequential accuracy and macro-F1 curves (windowed 100 and cumulative) vs number of reviewed items per arm; held-out checkpoint table (after 300 stream items, at end) with floor Jev+S and ceiling Jev+F; bootstrap CIs via `unified_stats`; spend table; caveats block (LLM-SME gold, enriched mix, one stream order cannot resolve < ~5 F1 points, real SMEs vaguer).

## Definition of done

Report renders from fake-run outputs offline; spec passes; no review or policy text in output.

## Caps

$0 (offline).
